name: agent-tree
description: Bottom HUD lines for Claude Code, merged into your status line, with an on-demand live agent tree pane, external workers, Fable advisor, opt-in Jev advisory flags and session stats.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval (ms)
refreshMs.description: How often the pane re-reads the agent list and session usage, in milliseconds.

autoOpen.title: Open pane at start
autoOpen.description: The pane opens on /agent-tree; set true to open it at start.

statusLineHud.title: Status line HUD
statusLineHud.description: Writes a small display snapshot under the Claude config folder for the agent-tree status line wrapper, and pins no status entry while on; no file is written while off.

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: Body columns the pane asks for when it docks beside the transcript. A request to Claude Code, not a guarantee: a width you drag or key the dock to wins.

workerCommands.title: External worker commands
workerCommands.description: Extra command names, comma-separated, that the pane shows as external workers when the shell tool runs them (added to the built-in list: kimi, grok, codex, opencode, gemini, chatgpt, mimo, claude, aider). Parsed on this machine only.

jevEnabled.title: Jev flags
jevEnabled.description: Send a privacy-limited session summary (tool names, counts, durations; no code, paths or prompts) to TypeSafe Jev for looping, stuck, fan-out and near-done flags. Needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment.

jevIntervalSec.title: Jev interval (s)
jevIntervalSec.description: Minimum seconds between two Jev calls; a call is made only when new events arrived since the last one.

jevMaxCallsPerHour.title: Jev calls per hour
jevMaxCallsPerHour.description: Upper bound on Jev calls in any hour.
